name: draw_proportional_text
proto: void draw_proportional_text(uint proport_seg, char *text)  /* Ghidra: (text=param_1, seg=param_2) */
purpose:
Vector 1778:0566 (INTRO story screens, FONT Create). Draws NUL-terminated `text` with the PROPORT.PCS glyphs (index = char - 0x20, draw_image_masked on page 1) word-wrapped and justified inside the layout block. band = 1 while 0x5150 < y(0x5158) < 0x5152 else 0; left = 0x5146[band], right = 0x514c[band]; cur = x(0x5156) - left. Per line: measure forward (byte < 0x21: g_font_space_width and count a space; '{': 15; '_': 0; else width[0x50ca + c] + 1) until NUL, '
' or cur >= right-left; back up: a NUL that fits or '
' breaks there; otherwise step back until the previous space (removed from the line) or a '_' soft hyphen that fits with a '-' (0x50f7) or the line start, un-measuring glyphs on the way. slack = line width - cur is distributed over the spaces (slack/spaces each, integer) unless the break is NUL/'
'. Glyphs are drawn only while y < 0xc0; a break at '_' draws glyph 0xd. After a line: y += 9, x = left of the new band, cur = 0, continue after the break byte. Ends on NUL with set_draw_page(0).

0x50ca.name: g_glyph_widths
0x50ca.meaning: proportional glyph width per character (tail of string 0x50bd)

notes: Ghidra typed 0x5154 as g_font_space_width; the listing accesses it as a word.

name: view_draw_cell
proto: void view_draw_cell(int col, int row)  /* Ghidra: (row, col) */
purpose: Draws one cell of the View scene (4 rows at screen rows 7..10). terrain = g_map[row*0x20+col]; non-zero: draw_tile(row+7, col, g_tile_anim_map[terrain]); zero: the object layer byte 0x6688[row*0x20+col] is drawn as tile 0x100+obj unless it is 0x16.

0x6688.name: g_view_object_layer
0x6688.meaning: object tiles stamped by view_idle_tick (= g_map + 0x80)

name: view_idle_tick
purpose: Vector 1778:0a3a; the View's frame loop, also called by ROOT tile_transition_effect while g_location == 'B'. Each frame: animate_monsters(); INTRO title_fire_tick (vector 1778:0572); every g_monster_table slot with tile != 0 writes 0 into g_map[y*0x20+x] and its animation tile into 0x6688[..]; columns 0xbd26..=0xbd27 x rows 0..3 are drawn with view_draw_cell unless the g_map byte is 0xfe; if 0xbd26 != 0 and the toggle 0xbd28 is set, the visible range widens by one column each side; 0xbd28 = !0xbd28. read_key() != 0 returns 1. count != 0: wait_ticks(1). Scene 0xbd29 == 2: play_random_tones(10000, 60, 20); == 3: 0x515a = (0x515a+1) mod 8, beep(3, 3000) at 0 and beep(3, 2000) at 4. count -= 1; 0 returns 0 (count 0 on entry therefore loops until a key).
notes: The tone argument 0x2710 is Ghidra's s_Missed_+1 (10000 decimal).

name: view_load_scene
purpose: Loads View scene `index` (0..3): INTRO draw_bottom_banner(0x515c[index]) (caption pointers 0xa010/0xa01e/0xa02a/0xa036), then the 19-column x 4-row block at g_ool_buffer + index*0x80 (stride 0x20, from MISCMAPS.DAT 0x2c0+) is copied into g_map 0x6608 and the ground copy 0x6708 at the same layout. 0xbd26 = 0xbd27 = 9, 0xbd28 = 0, 0xbd29 = index.

0x6708.name: g_view_ground_layer
0x6708.meaning: ground tiles restored under moved objects

name: run_the_view
purpose: Vector 1778:055a: 'the View' demo after the title / on 'R'. g_cell_h = 16; 0xbd26 = 0xbd27 = 9; 0xbd28 = 0; g_ui_color2 bar fill_rect(y 0x78..0x7e, x 0x78..199) + g_ui_color1 line at y 0x7f. If g_location != 'B': MISCMAPS.DAT 0x2c0.. (2000 bytes) -> g_ool_buffer; if g_location == '@': save the scratch segment (f032), load_picture_file(TILES.16) until it succeeds, restore (f05b). g_location = 'B'. Then interprets the script at g_ool_buffer[0x200..2000) (opcode byte, operands follow): 0 slot,tile,x,y place; 1 slot remove + restore ground; 2 slot,dir move (0x24d6/0x24de deltas) restoring ground; 3 n wait n frames; 4 x,y explosion frames 1..15 (draw_effect_frame, one frame each, key aborts) then ground/current = 0xdc, 2 frames; 5 implosion 15..1 at the last x,y then tile 5, 2 frames; 6 n view_load_scene(n); 7 slot: tile set to 0x16 and tile_transition_effect to 0x100+old tile, restore tile; 8 slot: same to the ground tile; 9 restart at 0x200; 10 tile,x,y set ground+current; 11 lightning: 5 pairs of lines from (x 0x98+3k, y 0x80+9k) to (0x9b+3k, 0x89+9k) with a frame each, draw_tile(0) at slot[+2]'s position, play_random_tones(4000,1200,1), 3 frames; 12 clear every slot's tile/anim/state; 13 slot,dir move then 7 frames; 14 n loop start; 15 loop end (jump back while --n). After each opcode read_key() != 0 returns; e += 1; e > 1999 returns.
notes: Opcode 5 reuses opcode 4's x,y locals (uninitialised if 5 comes first).

name: pick_unused_card
purpose: Returns a random card 0..7 (rand_range(7,0)) that is neither shown this round (0xbd2a[i] == 0) nor eliminated (0xbd32[i] == 0), marking 0xbd2a[i] = 1.

0xbd2a.name: g_create_card_shown
0xbd2a.meaning: card shown in the current round

name: ask_gypsy_question
proto: void ask_gypsy_question(uint font_seg, uint create_seg)  /* Ghidra: (create_seg, font_seg) */
purpose: One character-creation question. Page 1 cleared (put_char 0xff), CREATE.16 image 1 at x 0x10 and x 200 (card frames), text cursor (0,0x98). a = pick_unused_card, b = pick_unused_card; if b < a: letter 'B', left b, right a; else 'A', left a, right b. Left card: draw_image(image left+2 at (0x51fc[left], 0x5204[left])); right: at x+0xb8. QUESTION.DAT 2000 bytes from offset 0x517c[a][b] (8x8 u16) -> g_ool_buffer, draw_proportional_text, copy_page(0,1). Waits for A/B (read_key, to_upper). chosen = a and rejected = b when the key equals `letter`, else swapped. int/dex/str accumulators 0xbd3c/0xbd3d/0xbd3e += 0x5164/0x516c/0x5174[chosen]; 0xbd32[rejected] = 1.

name: create_new_character
purpose: Vector 1778:054e: 'Create New Character'. free_picture unless g_location == '@'; g_disk3_drive_letter = 0xff; PROPORT.PCS (load_file_to_mem) and CREATE.16 (load_image_file) loaded until they succeed; INIT.GAM (0x1060) over the save area 0x55a6; g_ui_color2 panel 0x78..0x7e with a g_ui_color1 line at 0x7f and a black box (8..0x80, 0x137..0xbf); 'By what name shalt thou be known?' at (0x11,3), ':' at (0x13,0xe), read_line(8) into g_party[0].name. Non-empty: 'Art thou Male or Female? ' at (0x15,8), M/F -> 0x55b1 = 0xb/0xc; layout block x 0, y 9, left 0/0xaf, right 0x140/0x140, band 0x59..200; QUESTION.DAT offset 0 -> g_ool_buffer; page 1, g_display_mode = 2, clear, CREATE.16 image 0 at y 0x60, text, copy to page 0, band y0 = 200, key wait; accumulators from INIT.GAM's int (0x55b6)/dex (0x55b5)/str (0x55b4); shown/out flags cleared; 4 questions, shown flags cleared, 2 questions, cleared, 1 question; closing text: y 0, x 0, band y0 0x5a, left1 0, right1 0xa6, space width 4, QUESTION.DAT 0x322, image 10 at (0xa8,100), space width 5, copy, key wait; free both buffers, page 1 cleared, page 0, g_display_mode = 0; int = MP = 0xbd3c, dex = 0xbd3d, str = max(0xbd3e, 20) unsigned; INIT.OOL (0x100) -> 0xb31e; clear screen, cursor (10,0), select_disk(3), g_ool_buffer[0..0x100] = 0, SAVED.OOL (0x200 from 0xb21e) and SAVED.GAM (0x1060 from 0x55a6) written. Always: select_disk(0), g_location = '@'.

0x55a8.name: g_party
0x55a8.meaning: record 0: name +0, gender +9 (0x55b1), str +0xc (0x55b4), dex +0xd (0x55b5), int +0xe (0x55b6), MP +0xf (0x55b7)

notes: The strength clamp is SUB/SBB/NOT/AND/ADD = unsigned max(str, 0x14).

name: save_scratch_to_overlay_area
purpose: If g_unk_520c == 0, g_unk_520c = vec_FLAMES_a290() (1778:057e, returns 0xa299 = the free level-2 overlay area). Copies 0x1800 words from g_scratch_seg:0 (the LZW dictionary scratch) to CS:g_unk_520c (REP MOVSW with DS = g_scratch_seg, ES = CS). Ghidra's decompilation shows DS:0 as the source; the listing loads DS from 0x5354.

0x520c.name: g_unk_520c
0x520c.meaning: code-segment offset of the saved scratch copy (0xa299)

notes: Port copies through gm.m between linear (scratch_seg << 4) and 0x10000 + g_unk_520c.

name: restore_scratch_from_overlay_area
purpose: Copies the 0x1800 words back from CS:g_unk_520c to g_scratch_seg:0 (DS = CS, ES = g_scratch_seg).
